title: Ring of Jumping
summary: Cast Enhance Leap as a Bonus Action once per Short Rest.

fields.Enhance Leap: Level 1. Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Target a creature within melee range. Its base jump distance triples for 10 turns, before flat jump bonuses. Most characters need a separate Bonus Action to jump after casting.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at Ebonlake Grotto.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
